tabs.label: Python
tabs.title: Generated Pipeline
tabs.sampleYaml:
name: CI Pipeline
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
reasons: Cached pip wheels generated for faster installs

tabs.label: Docker Monorepo
tabs.title: Generated Pipeline
tabs.sampleYaml:
name: CI Pipeline
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [api, worker, web]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Build ${{ matrix.service }}
        run: docker build ./${{ matrix.service }}
reasons: Monorepo structure mapped to a build matrix
